definitions.explanation: A formal discussion or argument on a particular topic, especially one in which opposing views are put forward.

examples.japanese: {討論|とうろん}が{始|はじ}まった。
この{問題|もんだい}について{討論|とうろん}する。
{選挙|せんきょ}{前|まえ}にテレビで{討論|とうろん}{会|かい}が{行|おこな}われた。
examples.english: A televised debate was held before the election.

examples.japanese: {学生|がくせい}たちが{環境|かんきょう}{問題|もんだい}について{熱心|ねっしん}に{討論|とうろん}していた。
examples.english: The students were passionately debating environmental issues.

examples.japanese: {国会|こっかい}では{新|あたら}しい{法案|ほうあん}について{何時間|なんじかん}も{討論|とうろん}が{続|つづ}いたが、{結論|けつろん}は{出|で}なかった。
examples.english: In the Diet, debate on the new bill continued for hours, but no conclusion was reached.

notes:
{討論|とうろん} refers to a formal debate where opposing views are presented and examined. Composed of {討|とう} (attack/discuss) + {論|ろん} (argument).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {討論|とうろん}する: to debate
- {討論|とうろん}{会|かい}: debate meeting, panel discussion
- {討論|とうろん}を{行|おこな}う: to hold a debate
- {活発|かっぱつ}な{討論|とうろん}: lively debate
- {公開|こうかい}{討論|とうろん}: public debate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {議論|ぎろん}: discussion, argument (broader — can be informal or heated)
- ディベート: debate (loanword, often used for formal competitive debate)
- {論争|ろんそう}: controversy, dispute (implies ongoing disagreement)
- {審議|しんぎ}: deliberation (formal, legislative)

Often used in political and academic contexts.
